body: Any chance you can attach a sample project that exhibits this behavior? I am asking because without it, we will be agnostic as to whether or not any potential fix actually addresses the issue.

> Any chance you can attach a sample project that exhibits this behavior? I am asking because without it, we will be agnostic as to whether or not any potential fix actually addresses the issue.

It's an NDA project, but I can try to make little sample

Looking at the stacktrace, I doubt we will be able to fix this, as the problem seems to be in Liquibase Pro class, whose sources we don't have and therefore it's pretty difficult to reason about what should do to overcome the problem. I can guess from the stacktrace, but it's only a guess...
